description: Property attributes (year built, sqft, value, owner) for a US address — returns 350+ data points from tax assessor & deed records including bedrooms/bathrooms, lot size, assessed & market value, and last sale. Example: smarty_property_enrichment({ street: "1400 Sandhill Rd", city: "Orem", state: "UT", _apiKey: "authId:authToken" })

_apiKey.description: Smarty credentials as "authId:authToken" (server key pair), or a single embedded/website key. Free account + 1000 lookups at smarty.com

city.description: City name (optional if included in street)

street.description: Street address, or a full freeform US address, e.g. "1400 Sandhill Rd" or "1400 Sandhill Rd, Orem, UT 84058"

name: smarty_property_enrichment
title: Smarty Property Enrichment
